genesis.coinbase_script_sig: single push of the 32 raw bytes of this profile digest
genesis.genesis_solution: generate offline; freeze the full serialized block and SHA256d header hash before launch

peer_policy: explicit lab peers only; default loopback
key_scope: fresh synthetic seeds per node; reject foreign address and key encodings
identity_derivation: first four SHA-256 bytes of ASCII digest-hex / label; no spaces or newline; labels wire, overwinter, sapling, bubbles, diffadj, buttercup, ironwood; branch IDs are big-endian integers
